title: REPORT on countering transnational repression – towards an EU strategy to protect Europe’s sovereignty and democratic values
part_text: to update guidance for asylum and migration authorities
part_context: Invites the Member States to update guidance for asylum and migration authorities to ensure that the individual circumstances of applicants who are victims of TNR are properly addressed; calls on the Member States and other Schengen area countries to use the EU’s Visa Code and Handbook consistently and flexibly to address protection needs for persons targeted by TNR;
